Set the key that signs the requests to your license server, turn sales on, and manage what was sold here. licenses.revoke_help: The license can no longer be activated or refreshed; its install keeps its last token until that ends, then new actions are gated. Nothing is deleted and no money moves.
licenses.need_key: Set the admin key above first: the licenses are read from the license server with it.
licenses.all_intro: Every license of the license server: your own store's, the ones made by hand and the ones the bot sold. A license you change here is changed on the license server; its install picks the change up at its next daily refresh.

licenses.end_date_help: YYYY-MM-DD, Gregorian, at most 10 years from today. Choose No end for a license without one.
licenses.default_help: A trial lasts its own 30 days from now.

general.title: General
general.desc: The time zone the bot shows dates in, and the bot’s own Telegram profile.

shop.title: Plans and bulk purchase
shop.desc: How the bot lists plans, and buying several services at once.

maintenance.title: Maintenance mode
maintenance.desc: Close the bot to customers for a while, for example while you move servers.

join.title: Required channels and groups
join.desc: Customers must join these before they can use the bot or the Mini App. The free tier and Standard allow one; Pro and the trial any number.
join.note: The bot must be an administrator of each channel or group to check who joined. For a private one, enter its numeric id (starting with -100) and put its invite link in “Join link”. The first row is the channel the bot’s /set join.channel changes; the order is the order customers are asked in. A name on the button is optional: without one, a public channel shows its {'@'}username.

notify.title: Staff notifications
notify.desc: Which events the bot reports in Telegram, and to whom.
notify.note: The “payment taken but not recorded” alert is always sent; it cannot be turned off.

limits.title: Limits
limits.desc: Keep floods of messages and tickets in check.

payments.title: Payment details
payments.desc: What the bot shows customers for card transfer, USDT, Telegram Stars and your Zarinpal link.

monitor.title: Monitoring
monitor.desc: What core watches on the server and in the stack, and when it raises an alert.

cashback.title: Cashback
cashback.desc: Give a share of what each order cost back to the customer's wallet once it is paid and delivered.
cashback.note: Cashback is credit in the wallet, not cash: it can only be spent in the store. If an order is refunded, its cashback is taken back from the refund. Resellers, free orders, free trials and orders priced in USDT earn none. Off until you turn it on.

targets.title: Reseller targets
targets.desc: A monthly bonus for resellers who sell enough new services.
targets.note: Each tier pays its own bonus, once for the month, as soon as a reseller's sales of the month reach it, on top of the bonuses of the lower tiers. Only new services a reseller bought and that were delivered count; renewals, traffic packages and free orders do not. Sales are counted from the moment you switch targets on. A refunded sale leaves the count of its month, but a bonus already paid is not taken back. Off until you turn it on.

wheel.title: Daily wheel
wheel.desc: One free spin a day for customers who have paid orders, for a chance at wallet credit.
wheel.note: The wheel stays closed until it has prizes and a daily budget. The draw is made by core, once per customer per day in store time. A prize the day's budget cannot cover is not paid and the customer's spin is not used: they are asked to come back tomorrow. Only customers spin, not resellers, staff or banned customers, and only after the paid orders you ask for (at least one). A prize is credit in the wallet, not cash: it can only be spent in the store. Off until you turn it on.

growth.title: Growth
growth.desc: Tools that help customers bring in more customers.

reports.title: Sales summary
reports.desc: A message in Telegram with yesterday's sales, once a day.

timezone.label: Time zone
timezone.help: The bot shows dates (such as when a service ends) in this time zone. “Server default” is BOBRES_TIMEZONE, else Tehran. Dates in this dashboard follow your own device’s clock.

bot_profile.label: Keep the bot’s Telegram profile up to date
bot_profile.help: The bot sets its menu commands, its description (the text of an empty chat) and its short description (its profile page), in Persian and English, from its texts: edit them under Branding & texts → Bot texts → Bot profile. It also sets its profile photo from Branding & texts → Store → Telegram bot. Turned off, it takes back its Persian and English texts and the staff menus, so what you set in {'@'}BotFather shows; the photo stays. The bot’s name is always set in {'@'}BotFather.

plan_layout.label: Plan list layout
plan_layout.help: How the bot lists plans when a customer buys or renews. A table puts each plan on a row of two buttons, its name and its price, under a header row. A list has one button per plan, with the name and the price together.

enabled.label: Bulk purchase
enabled.help: A Bulk purchase button on the bot’s home menu: a customer buys several services of one plan at once and pays for all of them from the wallet. Turned off, the button is gone and core refuses the purchase too.

max_quantity.label: Most services in a bulk purchase
max_quantity.help: The most services one bulk purchase may hold, from 2 to 100. Each service is an ordinary order; the whole purchase is made, or refused, together.

enabled.label: Maintenance mode
enabled.help: While on, customers only see the maintenance message. Staff can still use the bot and payments in progress finish. Change the message under Branding & texts.

channel.label: Channel
channel.help: A public channel’s {'@'}name, or a private channel’s numeric id. Empty turns the requirement off. Staff are never checked, and customers are let in if Telegram does not answer.

link.label: Join link
link.help: The bot’s “Join” button opens this link. A public channel can leave it empty; a private channel needs an invite link.

new_payment.label: New payment to review
new_payment.help: When a customer sends a card receipt, a USDT transaction or a Zarinpal reference, with a button to review it.

new_ticket.label: New support ticket
new_ticket.help: When a customer writes to support in the bot.

provision_failed.label: Service could not be created
provision_failed.help: When a paid service could not be created on the panel and needs a look.

system_alerts.label: System problems
system_alerts.help: When a service, a panel server, Zarinpal, the backups, the disk, paid orders, the bot's messages or the license has a problem, once a day while it lasts, and when it is fixed. Open problems always show on the System page.

sales.label: Every sale
sales.help: A message for every paid order, with the customer, plan and amount.

recipients.label: Recipients
recipients.help: “Only the store owner” is the Telegram account set as owner when BOBRES was installed. “Every owner and admin” is every active owner and admin; support staff get only the ticket alerts, never payment or sales ones.

bot_per_10s.label: Messages per user in 10 seconds
bot_per_10s.help: Someone who sends more messages or taps more buttons than this gets no answer until those 10 seconds are over. Stops spam and load on the server.

tickets_per_day.label: Tickets per customer per day
tickets_per_day.help: A customer cannot send more support tickets than this in 24 hours. 0 means no limit.

broadcast_per_sec.label: Broadcast messages per second
broadcast_per_sec.help: How fast broadcasts go out (1 to 25). Telegram allows about 30 messages a second for the whole bot; the bot's replies to customers go first and slow a broadcast down when it is busy.

card_number.label: Card number or sheba
card_number.help: Shown to customers for card-to-card payments: a 16-digit card number, or a sheba (IR and 24 digits). Empty turns card payments off.

card_holder.label: Card holder
card_holder.help: Shown next to the card number so customers know they pay the right person.

usdt_trc20.label: USDT address (TRC20)
usdt_trc20.help: Your Tron wallet address for USDT payments; it starts with T. Empty means this network is not offered.

usdt_erc20.label: USDT address (ERC20)
usdt_erc20.help: Your Ethereum wallet address for USDT payments; it starts with 0x. Empty means this network is not offered.

usdt_rate_auto.label: Live USDT rate
usdt_rate_auto.help: On: the Toman price of one USDT is read live every couple of minutes, and Toman prices are turned into USDT at that rate, so a crypto payment is priced at the moment. If the live price cannot be read, the rate below is used. Off: only the rate below.

usdt_rate_margin.label: Margin on the live rate (%)
usdt_rate_margin.help: Added on top of the live USDT price, to cover the exchange's spread and fees. 0 to 30; empty means none.

usdt_rate.label: Toman per USDT
usdt_rate.help: At this rate, Toman-priced plans can also be paid in USDT. Empty means USDT only for plans priced in USDT.

stars_rate.label: Toman per Telegram Star
stars_rate.help: For payments in Telegram Stars; amounts are rounded up to whole Stars. Empty means Stars are not offered.

zarinpal_link.label: Zarinpal link
zarinpal_link.help: Your own Zarinpal payment link (https). Customers pay there and send the reference for you to review.

enabled.label: Offer card to card
enabled.help: When off, customers do not see card to card, even with a card number set.

enabled.label: Offer USDT
enabled.help: When off, customers do not see USDT, even with an address set.

enabled.label: Offer the Zarinpal link
enabled.help: When off, customers do not see the link, even when it is set.

enabled.label: Offer Telegram Stars
enabled.help: When off, customers do not see Stars, even with a rate set.

enabled.label: Monitoring
enabled.help: Core records the figures of the server and of the stack every 30 seconds for the Monitoring page and raises its alerts. Turned off, it records and alerts nothing; the history stays readable.

disk_pct.label: Disk full alert (%)
disk_pct.help: A disk of BOBRES or of Docker that is fuller than this raises an alert.

mem_pct.label: Memory alert (%)
mem_pct.help: Memory use above this for the minutes below raises an alert.

mem_minutes.label: Memory alert after (minutes)
mem_minutes.help: How long memory must stay above the percent before the alert is raised.

restarts.label: Container restarts alert
restarts.help: A container that restarts this many times within 15 minutes raises an alert: it is in a crash loop.

collector_minutes.label: Collector silent for (minutes)
collector_minutes.help: Minutes without a snapshot from the host collector before an alert is raised. Only where the collector is installed.

ci_alert.label: Alert when CI on main fails
ci_alert.help: While the latest CI run on the repository's main branch has failed, an alert is raised. For a store built from main; leave it off for a store that runs releases.

enabled.label: Cashback
enabled.help: When on, an order that has been paid and delivered credits a share of its price to the customer's wallet, once. Turned off, nothing more is paid; what was paid stays in the wallets. Set the percent too.

percent.label: Cashback percent
percent.help: From 0.01 to 20, for example 2.5. It is worked out on what the order cost after any discount, in whole Toman, rounded down. Empty means no cashback.

max_per_order.label: Most cashback per order (Toman)
max_per_order.help: No order earns more than this. Empty or 0 means no maximum.

min_order.label: Smallest order that earns (Toman)
min_order.help: An order must cost at least this much, after any discount, to earn cashback. Empty or 0 means any order that costs something.

renewals.label: Renewals earn cashback
renewals.help: On: renewals and traffic packages earn it like new services. Off: only new services do.

enabled.label: Monthly targets
enabled.help: When on, a reseller whose new services of a month reach a tier is paid that tier's bonus, once for the month, into their wallet; they are told in the bot, and the Mini App and the bot show their progress. Turned off, nothing is counted or paid; what was paid stays.

tiers.label: Tiers
tiers.help: How many new services a reseller sells in a month, and the bonus in Toman for reaching that number. At most 10 tiers; each pays its own bonus on top of the lower tiers'. Changing the tiers in the middle of a month never pays a tier twice.

calendar.label: Calendar of the month
calendar.help: Gregorian: a month runs from the 1st to its last day (the 1st of November, for instance). Jalali: Persian months (the 1st of Aban). The month is read in the store's time zone. Change it between months, not in the middle of one.

enabled.label: Daily wheel
enabled.help: When on, a customer with enough paid orders may spin the wheel once a day, in the bot and in the Mini App. Turned off, the wheel is gone; prizes already paid stay in the wallets. It also needs prizes and a daily budget.

prizes.label: Prizes
prizes.help: What the wheel can pay, in Toman, and each prize's weight: its share of the chances. A prize of weight 3 comes up three times as often as one of weight 1. At most 12 prizes, no amount twice; saved in order of amount.

no_prize_weight.label: Weight of no prize
no_prize_weight.help: The chance of no prize is this number out of the sum of all the weights, the prizes' included. Empty or 0 means every spin wins something.

daily_budget.label: Daily budget (Toman)
daily_budget.help: The most the wheel pays out in one day (store time). Spins are decided one at a time against it: when it cannot cover the prize that comes up, nothing is paid, the customer's spin is not used and they are asked to come back tomorrow. Empty or 0 means the wheel is closed.

min_orders.label: Paid orders needed
min_orders.help: How many paid orders a customer needs before they may spin, at least 1: an account made only to spin earns nothing. Refunded orders and orders that cost nothing do not count.

enabled.label: Top users board
enabled.help: Shows customers a Top users board in the bot (a button on the main menu): the customers who invited the most people, five to a page, with each name and Telegram id masked. Staff, resellers and banned users are never on it, and it shows only while the referral program is on (Discounts & referrals → Invitations). On by default. Turned off, the button and the board are gone.

autoclose_days.label: Close answered tickets after (days)
autoclose_days.help: A ticket whose customer has not written back this many days after a staff reply is closed, without a message. 0 turns this off.

enabled.label: Subscription page
enabled.help: Every service gets its own page at /sub/<secret> with its link, QR code and app guides. Turned off, those addresses answer “not found” and the bot and dashboard stop showing them.

bot_username.label: Bot username
bot_username.help: The bot’s {'@'}username (without the {'@'}), for the “Renew” button on the subscription page, which opens the bot. Empty: the page has no renew button.

enabled.label: Gift codes
enabled.help: Customers can apply a gift code from the wallet screen in the bot: a code you made in the dashboard (Gift codes) adds a fixed amount to their wallet. Turned off, the button goes and no code is accepted; codes can still be made. Gift codes need the master key of the install.

enabled.label: Telegram Mini App store
enabled.help: Opens the store as a Mini App inside Telegram at /app/: plans, buying with the wallet or a payment gateway, services, renewing, wallet top-up, the free trial, invites and support. On by default: the bot opens it from a Store button and Telegram's menu button, which need the store's public HTTPS address, so there is nothing to set in {'@'}BotFather. Turned off, /app/ and its API answer “not found” and the buttons go.

daily_summary.label: Daily sales summary in Telegram
daily_summary.help: Every day at the time below, the bot messages yesterday's sales to every owner and admin: revenue per currency (never added together), paid orders, refunds, wallet top-ups, new customers and free trials. A day with no sales still gets a short message, so you can see it is working. Off until you turn it on; turned on after its time of day, it starts the next day.

daily_summary_time.label: Time it is sent
daily_summary_time.help: Time of day, 24-hour (for example 09:00), in the store's time zone: the time zone of the General card, else BOBRES_TIMEZONE, else Tehran. If the server was down at that time, the summary is sent as soon as it is back, the same day; days that were missed are not made up.

staff.no_owner: No store owner is set in the server settings, so any owner can give or take the owner role. Add one on the server: bobres admin owners add.
staff.owner_note: Named in the server settings (bobres admin owners); it cannot be changed here.
staff.role_intro: {name} is logged out everywhere and logs in again with a new link from the bot.
staff.same_role: This is their current role. Choose another one.

role_desc.support: Sees customers, services and payments, extends services and answers tickets.
role_desc.admin: Everything except staff, license, payment gateways and payment details.
role_desc.owner: Everything, including staff and payment details.

staff.revoke_all_intro: Every session of {name} ends. They log in again with a new link from the bot or with their password.
staff.reset_intro: The password and authenticator of {name} are deleted and they are logged out. They log in again with a new link from the bot (/dashboard) and can set a new password in My account.
staff.reset_done: Password reset. They need a new login link from the bot.
staff.unlocked: Unlocked. They can log in with their password again.
staff.remove_intro: {name} becomes a regular customer: dashboard access, password and sessions are removed. Their customer account, services and wallet stay.
staff.add_intro: Find the person among the bot's customers: they must have opened the bot at least once. Once added, they get their dashboard link with /dashboard in the bot.
staff.search_empty: Type a Telegram id or username to search.
staff.search_none: No one found. Only active customers who have opened the bot can be added.
staff.added_hint: They get their dashboard link with /dashboard in the bot.

audit.hint: Every change made by staff, the bot and the system, newest first. Entries cannot be edited or deleted.

gift_code.lock: Gift codes closed for a customer (too many wrong codes)

export.gift_redemptions: Uses of a gift code exported

reseller.group_sync: Reseller configs moved into their group again

support.search_hint: Search by ticket number (#1024), {'@'}username, Telegram id or words from the messages.
support.none_waiting: No ticket is waiting for an answer.
support.subject: Subject

close_reason.auto: Closed automatically: no answer from the customer
close_reason.merged: Merged into the customer's newer ticket

support.blocked_hint: The customer blocked the bot, so replies do not reach them. They get new replies only after they start the bot again.
support.reply_hint: The bot sends replies in the store's name, never yours. Only staff see internal notes. Ctrl+Enter sends.
support.discard_message: Your reply has not been sent and will be lost.
support.close_intro: The customer is told the ticket was closed. If they write again, a new ticket starts.
support.closed_hint: This ticket is closed. Reopen it to reply.
support.draft_kept: Your unsent reply is kept. Reopen the ticket to send it.

canned.hint: Ready texts staff insert into a reply: the text in the customer's language, or the other one when it is empty.
canned.title_hint: Only staff see it, in the list under the reply box.
canned.langs_hint: Write at least one language. Plain text only, up to 3,500 characters each.
canned.delete_confirm: Delete the saved reply {title}? Replies already sent stay as they are.

segment_desc.active: Customers with at least one active service.
segment_desc.expired: Customers who bought before but have no active service now.
segment_desc.never_bought: People who started the bot but have not bought anything yet.

list.empty: You have not sent a broadcast yet. One message can reach all your customers, or a group of them, in the bot.

audience.title: Recipients
audience.left_out: Banned customers and people who blocked the bot do not get it.

text.both_hint: Each customer gets the message in the language they chose in the bot, so write it in both languages.
text.one_hint: Only customers whose bot language is {lang} get this message.
text.empty: Write the message in this language.

button.title: Link button
button.add: Add a link button under the message
button.url_bad: Enter a full link that starts with https://
button.label: Button text ({lang})
button.label_chars: The characters {chars} are not allowed in a button.
button.label_long: At most {n} character. | At most {n} characters.

test.hint: Send to me sends the {lang} text to your own Telegram, so you can see it before everyone does.
test.ok: Test message sent to your Telegram.
test.blocked: It did not reach you. Start the bot from your own Telegram account first (/start), then try again.
test.bad_request: Telegram did not accept this message.
test.error: The bot could not send it.
test.unreachable: The bot cannot be reached right now. Try again in a minute.
test.rate_limited: At most 5 test messages a minute. Wait a moment.
test.invalid: The test was not sent. Fix the marked fields first.
test.failed: The test message was not sent.
test.need_text: Write the text in this language first.

save.wait_check: Wait a moment while the text is checked.

compose.scheduled_note: This broadcast is scheduled for {time}. Save changes keeps that time; to change it, use Schedule.

send.picker_note: Times are in this device's time zone ({zone}).
send.invalid: Enter a complete date and time.
send.past: Pick a time in the future.
send.confirm_now: This message goes to {n} customer now. Messages already sent cannot be taken back. | This message goes to {n} customers now. Messages already sent cannot be taken back.
send.confirm_later: This message goes to {n} customer on {time}. Until then you can still edit or cancel it. | This message goes to {n} customers on {time}. Until then you can still edit or cancel it.

send.zero: No customer matches this choice, so there is nothing to send.
send.stale: This broadcast was changed somewhere else after you opened it, so it was not sent. Check its latest version, then send again if you still want to.

leave.message: Your changes to this broadcast are not saved yet.

detail.done_of: {done} of {total} recipient done | {done} of {total} recipients done

detail.halted: The bot paused this broadcast. Fix the cause, then press Resume. The bot said:
detail.unknown_hint: Unknown means the bot could not tell whether Telegram delivered the message; these are never sent again.

action.cancel_message: Customers who have not got it yet will not get it. Messages already sent stay.

hint.failed: Telegram did not accept the message for these customers. Its answer says why.
hint.blocked: These customers blocked the bot. Until they start it again, they do not get later broadcasts either.
hint.unknown: It is not known whether the message reached these customers (for example, the connection to Telegram dropped). It is not sent again, so nobody gets it twice.

report.title: Daily wheel report
report.desc: What the wheel did today and on the days of the last month that had a spin, in store time.
report.off: The wheel is off or closed now: it needs to be switched on, with prizes and a daily budget.

targets.title: Monthly target
targets.next: {n} more service for the next bonus of {bonus}. | {n} more services for the next bonus of {bonus}.
targets.done: Every tier is reached this month.
targets.no_clawback: A refunded sale leaves the count, but a bonus already paid is not taken back.

reseller.none: No resellers yet. Make one from a customer's page, or with Add reseller.
reseller.limit_hint: How far below zero their wallet may go when they buy. 0 or empty: no credit.
reseller.limit_at_least: They owe {amount}: the limit cannot be lower.
reseller.customers_hint: Customers who joined through this reseller's link. Each of their purchases earns the reseller a commission.
reseller.customers_none: Nobody joined through this reseller's link yet.

rs.lost: A restore replaces ALL the store's data with the backup's. Orders, payments, new customers and services, wallet balances, tickets and settings go back to what the backup holds, and everything that happened after its time is gone. The dashboard cannot undo this.
rs.downtime: The dashboard and the bot are unavailable for a few minutes while the data is replaced. Customers' VPN links keep working.
rs.safe: A backup of the current data is taken first. If the restored store does not come back healthy, BOBRES goes back to that data on its own.
rs.key: Only a backup made by this server can be restored here: it is opened with this server's backup key. A backup from another server needs its own key, on the server: sudo bobres restore FILE --key-file KEYFILE.
rs.owners: Every owner is told on Telegram when the restore is asked for and when it ends, and both are recorded in the audit log.
rs.ack: I understand that everything after the backup's time is lost and that the dashboard and the bot are unavailable meanwhile.
